subject: [RFC PATCH 57/57] MAINTAINERS: add an entry for collapse

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Suggested that the patch should have the same maintainers/reviewers as the rest of THP, implying that it might be better to keep the logic in khugepaged.c.

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Agreed with Lorenzo's suggestion, implying that the patch might be too radical in separating the THP collapse logic.

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes to move the THP collapse logic from khugepaged.c into a new file, mm/collapse.c, and update the MAINTAINERS file accordingly. The patch separates the THP collapse functionality from the rest of the THP code and adds a new section for it in the MAINTAINERS file.
